data.name: Bardomiano
data.gender_notes: Bardomiano is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Bardus' meaning 'bold, brave' and 'manius' meaning 'man'. This name is derived from the Latin term 'Bardomannus' which was given to a courageous mountain dweller. The name Bardomiano carries the meaning “Bold, courageous mountain man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bardomiano usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, courageous mountain man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing bravery and courage in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Bardomiano belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bold, courageous mountain man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bardomiano total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

It encourages one to be strong in faith, to stand firm in the face of life's trials, and to trust in God's guidance and protection. The name serves as a reminder that God gives us the strength to face the challenges that come our way and to never give up in our spiritual journey.
